runtimeAuthority: database/sql files loaded by packages/server/src/infrastructure/sql-loader.ts; source paths below are pinned historical provenance

transactionScopes.docker-init: Existing compose initdb mount now reads database/sql/00-bootstrap/postgis.sql; only a fresh PostgreSQL data directory; separate from migrate().
transactionScopes.query-batch: Each SQL file replaces its original multi-statement literal in one pool.query call. Keep sequential call order; no explicit app transaction encloses all six calls.
transactionScopes.usp: One explicit transaction via db.transaction; acquire usp-migration-ledger advisory transaction lock before ledger checks and DDL; commit only after geometry marker.
transactionScopes.spatial-datasets: One explicit transaction via db.transaction, guarded by in-process ready promise; acquire spatial-dataset-schema-v1 advisory transaction lock first.
transactionScopes.dataset-ml: After ensureSpatialDatasets(), one explicit transaction via db.transaction, guarded by in-process ready promise; acquire dataset-ml-schema-v1 advisory transaction lock first.

steps.condition: Only on new PostgreSQL data directory

dataDependent: Backfill identity_floors from all historical units whose case/label is absent, including inactive units.
Backfill identity_spaces for units without an identity-space row; ordinals derive from existing maximum and creation order.
Insert one map_areas row per existing registry_sites row when that site has no area; ON CONFLICT(site_id) DO NOTHING.

internalConditions: DO block creates only absent USP reader/display roles, rejects unsafe pre-existing role attributes, then grants role membership to current_user.
Six NOT VALID constraints reject future incompatible writes without validating historical rows.
